name: MITA Data Centre
notes: MITA official page lists its Data Centre at Old Railway Track, Santa Venera SVR9019 and describes on-premises hosting within MITA data centres for public-sector systems. Times of Malta reported the MITA-01 Santa Venera data centre launch in 2011; capacity not disclosed.

name: Epic Malta data centre
notes: Epic's official business page offers data centre, co-location and disaster recovery services; directory evidence places the facility at MAR Building, Canon Road, St Venera SVR 9030. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Continent 8 Malta DC2
notes: Continent 8 official pages identify Malta as a location and offer co-location in its global network of data centres; directory evidence identifies Malta DC2 at 272 Cannon Rd, St Venera. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Melita Primary Data Centre
notes: Melita official pages describe the Madliena Primary Data Centre as Malta's only purpose-built Tier III-specification facility with a fully fenced 10,000 m2 footprint; ERA permit page gives the location as Triq il-Madliena, Madliena, Swieqi SWQ1013. Capacity not disclosed.
